ChapterOne is a local desktop writing app. Your selected AI providers receive prompts and manuscript context. Provider accounts and any API charges are separate from the app.

| Download | System |
| --- | --- |
| `mac-universal.dmg` | macOS 13+, Intel or Apple Silicon; drag ChapterOne to Applications |
| `mac-universal.zip` | The same macOS app in a ZIP archive |
| `win-x64-setup.exe` | Windows 10/11, Intel or AMD 64-bit |
| `win-arm64-setup.exe` | Windows 11 on ARM64 |

The macOS release is signed and notarized. Windows signing is optional; check the installer's **Properties → Digital Signatures**. Unsigned Windows builds can show SmartScreen warnings. SHA256 checksums for all installers are attached.

Install one supported writing CLI, or configure a Gemini API key in Settings. Node.js is included for the desktop app; installing npm-based CLIs requires a separate Node.js installation. See the README for setup, privacy, and known limitations.
